lead: The floor check `dossier: the chain already names every emitted goal` turns red on its own the session a reference chapter grows a heading.
body: A heading under `docs/reference/` *is* a feature (`rule:testing/roster-is-derived`), so features nobody planned become owed and unclaimed, and the ledger's "lacks ... nothing appended" reads exactly like unwritten work. Run `python tools/dossier.py --emit-goals` and stage `docs/agent/goals/` whole: it appends the goal, renumbers the `position: last` tail and leaves the live goal alone.
